    conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")

    for row in cursor.fetchall():

python3 -c '
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")
c = conn.cursor()

def get_val(query):
    c.execute(query)
    return float(c.fetchone()[0])

reserves_31 = get_val("SELECT sum(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = \"2025-03-31\"")
circ_31 = get_val("SELECT sum(CASE WHEN measure = \"total supply\" THEN amount_usdc ELSE -amount_usdc END) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = \"2025-03-31\"")
reserves_19 = get_val("SELECT sum(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = \"2025-03-19\"")
circ_19 = get_val("SELECT sum(CASE WHEN measure = \"total supply\" THEN amount_usdc ELSE -amount_usdc END) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = \"2025-03-19\"")

residual = get_val("SELECT reported_total_usd FROM reported_reserve_totals WHERE report_date = \"2025-03-31\"") - reserves_31

cov_31 = reserves_31 / circ_31
cov_19 = reserves_19 / circ_19
cov_change_bps = (cov_31 - cov_19) * 10000

print(f"reserves_31: {reserves_31}")
print(f"circ_31: {circ_31}")
print(f"residual: {residual}")
print(f"cov_change_bps: {cov_change_bps}")

print(f"cov_31: {cov_31}")
print(f"cov_19: {cov_19}")
'

import sqlite3
c = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite").cursor()
sql = """
SELECT
  (
    (CAST((SELECT sum(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = \"2025-03-31\") AS REAL) /
    CAST((SELECT sum(CASE WHEN measure = \"total supply\" THEN amount_usdc ELSE -amount_usdc END) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = \"2025-03-31\") AS REAL))
    -
    (CAST((SELECT sum(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = \"2025-03-19\") AS REAL) /
    CAST((SELECT sum(CASE WHEN measure = \"total supply\" THEN amount_usdc ELSE -amount_usdc END) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = \"2025-03-19\") AS REAL))
  ) * 10000.0
"""
print(c.execute(sql).fetchone()[0])
'
